artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G - Future Data-Governance Checklist

checklist_items.specification: Prospective forward evaluation requires an explicit, legally compliant institutional market data subscription (e.g. Tiingo Commercial/Institutional API, Polygon.io, or Direct Brokerage Feed). No automated scraping or unauthorized redistribution is permitted.
checklist_items.readiness_verdict: CONDITIONAL (Pending human repository owner vendor procurement)

checklist_items.specification: Tier 3 historical observations (2022-01-01 to Present) remain permanently quarantined and sealed. Forward prospective evaluation must begin on an explicit future calendar date T_0 and must not draw from historical Tier 3 archives.
All incoming market observations must record both UTC ISO-8601 timestamps and US Eastern (EST/EDT) market-session identifiers to prevent DST or calendar misalignment.
Automated pre-flight validation on incoming daily bar files: checks for non-null OHLCV, high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), positive prices, and volume >= 0.
Dividends and splits ingested exclusively from official exchange notices with 10-business-day settlement imputation. Retroactive adjustments recorded via append-only revision records.
Daily prospective bar files and trade logs are hashed with SHA-256 and committed to an append-only JSONL event journal to guarantee tamper-proof reproducibility.
The system must be capable of rebuilding the exact daily portfolio state, cash balance, and NAV curve from scratch by replaying the prospective event journal.
All forward paper evaluation evidence remains private to the workspace. No public release, web deployment, or external transmission without explicit human owner consent.

governance_summary.legal_data_rights_status: CONDITIONAL (Human repository owner must procure authorized commercial feed before activation)
